call.text: Recurrent models typically factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences and generate a sequence of hidden states h_t as a function of the previous hidden state h_t‑1 and the input for position t [AIAYN:1:c002]. This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths because memory constraints limit batching across examples [AIAYN:1:c002].
